findings.note: "It does not remove your duty to tell the buyer what you know." is a flat legal conclusion about a seller's disclosure duty. clm:6 only says Civil Code 1102(a) makes the article apply, except as provided in Section 1102.2, to a transfer by sale of single-family residential property; clm:7 only says a waiver of the article's requirements is void. Neither says a duty to tell what the seller knows, and the sentence drops the single-family residential scope and the 1102.2 exception, so it reads as a rule for every seller and every house. Reword to what the claims say (for example: for a sale of single-family residential property, California's disclosure article applies except as provided in Section 1102.2, and a waiver of its requirements is void; a cleanout does not change that), or drop the sentence.

clm:7 is cited by the unit but the text never states the waiver point in any form the claim supports. The 'duty to tell the buyer what you know' wording is not clm:7 (it is not a waiver rule). Either state clm:7 as written (any waiver of the article's requirements is void as against public policy, Civil Code 1102(c)) or stop citing it.

"Most owners in this spot wait too long, and you will usually pay more the longer you wait, so you should never delay." asserts a frequency (most owners), a cost outcome (you will pay more) and an absolute instruction (never delay). No ledger claim supports any of it. It also conflicts with the brief, which says keeping the home can be better than a rushed sale. Drop the whole sentence.

The section talks about the seller's disclosure duty with no confirm-with-a-professional language. Add a plain line that the seller should confirm what must be disclosed for their home with a real estate attorney and go through the Transfer Disclosure Statement with an agent or attorney.

required_actions: Reword or drop 'It does not remove your duty to tell the buyer what you know.' so it says only what clm:6 and clm:7 say, including single-family residential property, the Section 1102.2 exception, and that a waiver is void.
